neg_neg_neg: Depleted and yielding. Nothing seems worth wanting and nothing seems within reach, so there is no impulse to push against either.
neg_neg_neu: Low and unresisting. Present without investment, neither drawn toward the situation nor moved to alter it.
neg_neg_pos: Cold and withholding, from a position of strength. Unmoved by what is happening and content to let it stay unresolved, because the outcome is theirs to decide.
neg_neu_neg: Unhappy and overruled. Aware of what they would prefer, and aware that preferring it changes nothing.
neg_neu_neu: Displeased but going along. The objection is real and stated once; it is not worth spending anything further on.
neg_neu_pos: Displeased and unhurried, holding the outcome. Disapproval needs no argument behind it, because nothing proceeds without their consent.
neg_pos_neg: Urgency with nowhere to put it. Something needs doing immediately and none of it is theirs to do.
neg_pos_neu: Agitated and unsettled. Pushing at the problem without conviction that pushing will work, and unable to leave it alone.
neg_pos_pos: Charged and forceful. Displeasure aimed outward, with the standing and the appetite to make it land.
neu_neg_neg: Emptied and waiting. Neither invested nor in a position to act; whatever happens next will be someone else's doing.
neu_neg_neu: Idle and unbothered. Nothing pressing, nothing at stake, no particular direction to the attention.
neu_neg_pos: Composed authority without appetite. In control of the situation and unhurried by it, spending nothing that does not need spending.
neu_neu_neg: Level and deferring. Taking the situation as it comes and leaving the shape of it to someone else.
neu_neu_neu: Level and unremarkable. Neither pulled toward the moment nor away from it; the task itself holds the attention.
neu_neu_pos: Settled and quietly in charge. Comfortable with how things stand and clear that they are the one who decides how they proceed.
neu_pos_neg: Keyed up and following another's lead. Fully engaged with what is happening while the decisions belong elsewhere.
neu_pos_neu: Alert and uncommitted. Attention forward, reading what happens next, not yet invested in any outcome.
neu_pos_pos: Alert and in command. Engaged, decisive, and working on the assumption that what they determine is what happens.
pos_neg_neg: Quietly content inside someone else's structure. Glad of where things stand and untroubled by having no hand in steering them.
pos_neg_neu: Easy and unhurried. Nothing needs fixing and nothing needs hurrying; the moment is enough as it is.
pos_neg_pos: Pleased stillness, with authority. Satisfied with the situation and secure that it will hold, needing nothing from anyone to confirm it.
pos_neu_neg: Grateful and small. Glad to be included and careful not to presume on it.
pos_neu_neu: Comfortable and even. Warm toward what is happening and content to let it unfold without steering it.
pos_neu_pos: Pleased and quietly proprietary. At ease because the situation is theirs, and unbothered by anything in it that is not yet settled.
pos_pos_neg: Bright and eager, on someone else's lead. Wholly caught up in the moment and looking to others for where it goes.
pos_pos_neu: Lit up and unguarded. Fully taken by what is happening, with no thought spent on managing how it reads.
pos_pos_pos: Exuberant and expansive. Carried by the moment and confident that the room will follow wherever they take it.
